<!-- pr-reviewer: 03f23c7c5f41859fad36b34cc5cc35f628d71712 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge**

Read-only docs review (no build).

Verified against main:
- Every tool name in the tool table is registered under `crates/app/src/mcp/` (checked by name). The argument names in the example session (`catalog`, `box`, `output`) appear in the schemas (`mcp/tools.rs`, `mcp/edit.rs`).
- `camcraft-cli mcp` and `--connect` (`crates/app/src/cli.rs:27-39`, `:192`), `--mcp-port` and `CAMCRAFT_MCP_PORT` (`crates/app/src/mcp/listen.rs:189-196`), the five-minute idle timeout (`listen.rs:61`, `5 * 60`), and loopback-only listening.
- The "unexpected fault is reported as a refusal" claim matches the `catch_unwind` in `crates/app/src/mcp/mod.rs:155`.
- `Fixes #1247` is satisfied: a connect path, both run modes, a client config example, the tool list and an example session.

Notes (not blocking): the "port 0 picks a free port" line was not checked.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
